description: This file defines a Vue.js store using Pinia for managing user messages, including message types, error handling, and message display logic.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: Represents a user message with type, timestamp, timeout, content, and additional data.

methods.name: addMessage
methods.description: Adds a new message to the store and optionally displays it based on showTimeout.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds an error message, with special handling for ResponseError objects.

methods.name: addPreparedMessage
methods.description: Adds predefined success, warning, or info messages based on the prepared message type.

methods.name: flattenObject
methods.description: Recursively flattens nested objects into a single-level object with dot-separated keys.

methods.name: deleteAllMessages
methods.description: Clears all messages from the store.
